tools.name: search_indicators
tools.description: Use this when the user names an economic, social or environmental measure in words and you need its World Development Indicators code before comparing or ranking countries. Common indicators are listed first. Returns up to 15 codes and names. Does not return data values.

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare 2 to 12 countries on 1 to 4 World Bank indicators over a year range, for example GDP per capita PPP, inflation, population, unemployment, CO2 or life expectancy. Returns the latest value and year per country, first value, change, CAGR and missing years, a char

tools.name: rank_countries
tools.description: Use this when the user wants countries ranked on one World Bank indicator for a year, optionally within a region or income group, for example the highest life expectancy in Sub-Saharan Africa.
